purpose: Screen the three bounded P4 hypotheses from P4_AUDIT.md against the current sealed 27.09 detector. No detector or label changes are part of this experiment.

reference.gate_status: passed; all 208 enforced rows identical to the 2026-09-27 quality baseline

candidates.target: Set O top object #8 (big_above): sustained STOP distance / STOP frames
Set O edge cube #4 (small_edge_inside): STOP frames and first STOP distance
Set O edge box #6 (big_edge_inside): STOP frames and first STOP distance

stage_1_screen.data: The exact 1,510-frame cached set O from the full-gate run; unchanged labels, matching, visibility denominators and geometric safety exclusions.
reject_if: The named target has no improvement in its registered STOP measure.
Any other inside object loses STOP frames, first-STOP distance, held-from distance, per-range-bin STOP count, or missed-interval coverage.
Any outside-object or background false-STOP metric increases.

later_stages_for_each_stage_1_pass: Six original recordings: no weaker labelled detection, no increase in false events or STOP episodes.
Strict full regression gate against docs/evidence/results/regression_baseline_2026-09-27_quality.json, with the full ride and set F straight and no waivers.

Startup census, recorded-rate/5 Hz/+3 degree roll/+3 degree pitch, five start offsets, clear-distance, and the same paired set F/set S inputs and trajectories as the reference. No deterioration in false alarms, positive detections, range or clear-distance overclaims.
Only candidates passing every comparison may be considered for an A/B/C-order combination; the combination must pass all acceptance checks again.
interpretation_limits: Set O is previously inspected synthetic-obstacle data, not unseen validation.
The ride contains no real obstacles.
Set F and set S objects are synthetic; anchored placement is not surveyed ground truth.
No score increase is inferred from a candidate screen.
